subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: What should OpenClaw's permanent dynamic model discovery contract be for OpenRouter and gateway-style providers?
rationale: The current code has infrastructure and partial mitigations, but deciding default picker scope, wildcard/allowlist behavior, cache/offline policy, endpoint trust, and whether this is provider-owned plugin behavior or a core catalog source is a product/API choice.

options.title: Provider-owned live catalogs
options.body: Use the guarded plugin SDK live catalog path per provider, with explicit wildcard, cache, and fallback rules; this preserves core/plugin ownership and builds on current infrastructure.

options.title: Generated catalog refresh
options.body: Add a config or command-driven refresh that writes local catalog rows, which may help offline use but needs stricter migration and SecretRef-safe write policy.

options.title: Runtime fallback only
options.body: Continue synthesizing unknown models at execution time and leave list/picker discovery incomplete, accepting weaker UX for fast-moving catalogs.

recommendation.title: Provider-owned live catalogs
recommendation.body: Use the guarded plugin SDK live catalog path per provider, with explicit wildcard, cache, and fallback rules; this preserves core/plugin ownership and builds on current infrastructure.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to joshp123 and the remaining question is a product/API direction choice rather than a line-level repair.
